scope: Publish 14.1 stat-migration tables, server-owned allocation sessions, tutorial commit path, authenticated Image Designer commit, and retained client command protocol.

semanticReference.purpose: Behavioral reference for nine-attribute bounds, totals, and server-authoritative migration validation.

commitBoundaries.tutorial: Validated targets are applied immediately in newbie_hall and consumed once.
commitBoundaries.normalWorld: Validated targets remain server-owned until an authenticated, non-self Image Designer transaction commits them in the original salon structure.

requirements: exact designer, recipient, terminal, and starting-time identity
both participants remain in the original salon structure
recipient has a valid zero-points-left nine-stat allocation
imageDesignerCommit.consumption: The allocation is revalidated immediately before mutation and erased after one successful commit.

knownLimitations.imageDesignerCommit: Restored for authenticated normal-world salon transactions.
knownLimitations.sessionPersistence: Pending allocations remain process-local and are lost on game-server restart.
